about.title: About us
about.story: We are an industrial and trade food company founded in 2015. The office is located in the world's small commodity city - Yiwu. The company specializes in candy production activities. Products are exported to Russia, the Middle East, South America, Southeast Asia and African countries. We specialize in marshmallows, gummies and all kinds of handmade hard candies. Support various OEMs. We warmly welcome customers from all over the world to visit our company and consult us by email.
about.closing: There is nothing sweeter than bringing joy to people around the world!
